title: EU’s Digital Fairness Act proposal advances ‘ambitious’ ticketing reform
summary: The European Commission today formalised the proposal for the Digital Fairness Act (DFA), progressing a pan-European crackdown on dynamic pricing and resale in what one commissioner says is the “most ambitious reform” of consumer protection rules in a generation. title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala & SZA to lead Coachella 2027
summary: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA are set to headline the 26th instalment of the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. The Goldenvoice-promoted, 125,000-capacity festival will return to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, across two weekends: 9-11 & 16-18 April 2027. The trio of rumoured headliners were confirmed today (11 November), with Lipa closing Friday night, Tame Impala for Saturday, and SZA set for Sunday.
